about: NPC activities (minigames) and when they are offered; read by scripts/learning/activity_board.gd. Each id is '<kind>_<npc or store>' (the shop and cashier ids follow data/shops.json). 'chance' (0 to 1) is the probability the NPC offers its activity, rolled when the player arrives (shop and cashier: entering the store's zone; Dr. Li: coming within her calling distance) and once at start-up. 'progress' is how many rounds a session needs (0: no progress bar); only rounds answered right the first time count, and reaching it ends the session with the NPC's thanks. Only one activity runs at a time: another NPC politely refuses meanwhile. User decisions, 4 Nov 2026: every chance 1.0 for testing; cashier 5 rounds, family 20, the grocery order is one round with no bar. 5 Nov 2026: the warehouse (Ramón) is 5 tasks per session; a task counts when done, however many tries it took. 5 Nov 2026: the airport flight game (Captain Bruno) is 5 flights per session, counted only when found on the first tap. 6 Nov 2026: the Alta Cocina restaurant game (Twinkle) is one meal of 4 courses per session; a course counts once the right dish is served, however many tries it took. See docs/guides/ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW_PART1.md#shared-dialogue-popups-and-settings--4-november-2026. 6 Nov 2026: the police lineup (Officer Rocco, crocodile) and the evidence game (Officer Mimi, cat) are 4 rounds each; a round counts once solved, however many tries it took (docs/evidence/police-detective-20261106/PROMPT.md). 6 Nov 2026: the Grammar Classroom (Lana, school) is 10 questions per class (5 since 14 Nov 2026, each miss repeated once, at most 10); the bar shows the points (right answers) (docs/guides/GRAMMAR_CLASS.md). 8 Nov 2026: the warehouse (Ramón) is 10 tasks per session (user decision, for testing), and at the end Ramón asks to play again. 9 Nov 2026: Hong Kong mahjong with Mei (cat plush) at the table in front of the home is one hand per game with no progress bar (docs/guides/MAHJONG.md). 9 Nov 2026: 'kind' is 'learning' (the default) or 'pastime' (played for fun, no tested word: mahjong); the test launcher (scripts/ui/game_launcher.gd) groups the games by it and may set another number of rounds for one test game (activity_board.gd set_rounds()); 'progress' 0 plays one round (one order, one hand). 9 Nov 2026: Radar Patrol (docs/guides/RADAR_PATROL.md) is a pastime with no NPC, started by a click or E on either control-tower radar; chance 0 (never offered), one endless game (the launcher's rounds do not apply). 9 Nov 2026: Mystery Doors with Madame Luna (cat plush) in the Mystery House is 6 doors per game; a door counts when opened at the first try (docs/guides/TOWN_DESIGN_BRIEF.md 'Mystery House and Mystery Doors'). 9 Nov 2026: electrical box repair (docs/guides/ELECTRICAL_BOX.md) is a pastime with no NPC, started by E near or a click on any electrical box; chance 0 (never offered), one puzzle per opening (the launcher's rounds do not apply; its Play opens the nearest box). 18 Nov 2026: the bank teller game (bear banker, teller window 2) is 5 customers per session; a customer counts when served right the first time (exact cash, or a correct 'not enough money').
